original_test_intent: Write one approved three-field BIOS revision tuple to the BMC/vendor metadata location, verify every consumer reports that tuple and determine persistence, without altering BIOS image contents.
original_method: Retain the 0x30/0x02 source and request-field definition, but issue no write until the vendor contract resolves selector/payload framing, storage scope and the authoritative getter/restoration method.
manual_activity: The BIOS/BMC owner confirms that 0x30/0x02 changes metadata rather than firmware, approves the exact major/minor/AUX tuple, encoding, final state and recovery, and accepts the risk of temporary inventory mismatch.
required_inputs: Resolution of selector versus three revision bytes
Current reported tuple and actual BIOS image/version evidence
Named metadata storage and persistence behavior
Dedicated maintenance window and explicit approval
safety_requirements: Do not flash BIOS or change setup variables
Never guess revision bytes or selector placement
Do not allow false metadata to drive update automation
Validate every consumer and persistence boundary
Restore original tuple on mismatch or planned rollback
No reset/power action unless separately approved
agent_execution_scope: Verify hardware, actual BIOS image/version and approved metadata contract
Capture all current reported revision consumers
Present exact tuple, raw bytes and expected scope for OK
Read back all three fields through the authoritative getter
Compare reported metadata with actual firmware and flag intentional mismatch
Restore baseline when required and archive evidence
engineer_actions: Resolve request framing and prove metadata-versus-firmware scope
Approve tuple, encoding, consumers and persistence
Prevent automated decisions from trusting temporary false metadata

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its bare OOB request contains none of the three documented revision fields and cannot perform the claimed set; lan print has no BIOS-revision coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After vendor approval, issue one raw 0x30 0x02 <approved-major> <approved-minor> <approved-aux> request using the documented selector layout, then read back every field and consumer without flashing BIOS.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source's three-field order and 10/5 timing are retained; actual bytes, selector ordering, persistence and getter are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the operation as controlled firmware-identity metadata mutation: capture actual and reported versions, make one byte-defined change, verify consumers/persistence and restore before the mismatch can influence service tooling.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds payload, scope, semantic read-back and inventory-consistency safeguards while explicitly excluding BIOS flashing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Changing version metadata does not update, validate or attest BIOS executable content; firmware-update coverage remains entirely separate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: False major/minor/build metadata can cause incorrect upgrade/downgrade, compatibility, warranty or field-service decisions even if the server continues to boot normally.

project_override_considerations: A vendor manufacturing tool may substitute only with documented access to the same metadata fields and identical consumer/persistence evidence; a BIOS flash or dmidecode-only check is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Approved hardware/firmware identity, setter schema, tuple and owner confirmation
Actual BIOS image/version evidence plus baseline metadata from all named consumers
Redacted exact request/response, completion, tuple bytes and timing
Inventory/update-tool discrepancy guard during the test

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The note defines three revision request bytes, yet the in-band command supplies only an Ethernet Interface Select and the OOB command supplies no data. These request forms cannot perform the documented three-byte setter without a vendor-defined layout.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The metadata-write intent and named fields are identifiable. Vendor framing, exact tuple, read-back and recovery are explicit prerequisites, so the case remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.

review_improvement: Prevents a parameterless command from becoming either a false BIOS update claim or corrupted identity, and requires actual-firmware versus reported-metadata separation throughout the lifecycle.
independent_technical_reasoning: A revision tuple is a label, not firmware content. If the BMC accepts arbitrary metadata, command success can make inventory appear healthy or upgraded while the executable BIOS is unchanged. Byte-exact input, independent actual-version evidence and consumer-wide read-back are therefore necessary, followed by restoration before external automation acts on the temporary label.
